note: Trusted principal side channel. Wire: new optional request header field "principal" ({"name", "authorities"?, "attributes"?}; at most 1024 authorities and 1024 attributes) set only by the host, never derived from client headers. vespera_inprocess: new Principal request extension + extractor (401 MissingPrincipal when absent; Option<Principal> and Extension<Principal> also work), RequestEnvelope gained a principal field (struct literals need principal: None). Bridge: new PrincipalResolver strategy bean (default ServletPrincipalResolver: HttpServletRequest#getUserPrincipal plus Spring Security authorities, read reflectively) and VesperaPrincipal; the proxy forwards the authenticated principal by default (vespera.bridge.forward-principal=false disables); VesperaBridge.HeaderSource gained a principal() default method.
